title: Accelerated Information Propagation in Bosonic Lattices
exact_target: Identify when information in bosonic lattices propagates faster than a uniform finite-speed light cone.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005663 (OWR-14297742-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/39, pp. 2247--2302. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The allowed states and interaction decay matter because local bosonic operators are unbounded. Both nearest-neighbor and long-range interactions remain within the question.
